question: Two inputs should always show the same text, but each keeps its own useState. Fix?
options: Lift the text to the common parent and pass it down
say: Two inputs should always show the same text, but each keeps its own use state. What is the fix?
explanation: Duplicated state drifts apart. Give the text one owner: the common parent holds it and passes it and a change handler down.
explainSay: Lift the text up to the common parent, and pass it down with a change handler.
